text:
ana: Quick preflight — aiming to cut v0.23.1 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need a short owners sweep: version bump, changelog nudge, docs check, security scan, QA smoke. Branch to coordinate: release/v0.23. Please rebase off main and hold other feature merges.

jordan: On it. Which PR needs the version bump? I can take the package.json change.

ana: @jordan main bump is in PR #4572 (pkg/version) and there's a webapp package.json bump in #4589. Also please coordinate with @kevin for docker tags.

jordan: Gotcha, rebase and bump. I'll ping when pushed.

kevin: I'll update the docker tag and kick an image build. Tag will be redwood/v0.23.1. Pinging infra for the build window.

mira: QA here — can we lock smoke tests to the release branch? Acceptance criteria: no regressions on streaming + cache key behavior. Suggested smoke command: `./scripts/ci smoke --suite streaming,cache`

sheila-qa: Mira — I ran a quick prerelease on staging and saw one flake in long-tail streaming (timeout ~30s). Quarantining that test for now and re-running full suite. /cc @mira

liz-docs: Docs: changelog needs a short bullet for "improved KV cache eviction behavior" and an upgrade note for config parity. I'll draft a PR — tag me when the final changelog items land.

sam-sec: I'll run Snyk & dep-audit now and report results here. If anything high/critical shows up I'll block. ETA ~45m.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for branch release/v0.23: build #1289, status: running. <https://ci.internal/build/1289>

jordan: Rebased PR #4589 -> pushed. Bumped versions in two packages. PTAL @ana @kevin

kevin: Confirmed docker build kicked off, image sha abc123. Waiting for infra to promote to canary.

deploy-bot: CI build #1289 passed unit tests, integration tests queued. status: passed -> queued

sam-sec: Snyk report: no high/critical findings in direct deps. One low-severity in devDependency (dev only). Not blocking.

ana: Quick checklist for owners (short):
- @jordan: version bump merged
- @kevin: docker image built & pushed to internal registry
- @mira / @sheila-qa: smoke green or quarantine notes posted
- @sam-sec: security pass
- @liz-docs: changelog PR open
If all green, I'll cut at 09:00 PT and trigger canary.

mira: Starting the smoke run now. If streaming flake reappears I'll paste logs. Note: run smoke with `--concurrency 4` to mirror canary load.

sheila-qa: Smoke run completed: green on staging with concurrency=4. Long-tail streaming flake resolved after quarantine fix. No regressions on cache tests.

liz-docs: Opened PR #4620 with changelog entry + upgrade guide snippet.

kevin: Infra promoted image to canary repo: redwood/v0.23.1-canary -> sha abc123.

ana: Awesome. If nobody objects I'll proceed with cut at 09:00 PT. Any last blockers?

jordan: No blockers here. :thumbsup:

mira: No blockers from QA.

sam-sec: No blockers from security.

ana: Cutting in 10m. I'll post cut confirmation and a short rollback plan when done.

deploy-bot: Release cut job started: cut-v0.23.1 -> in progress. <https://ci.internal/release/cut/2301>
